style.name: Blue-and-white Porcelain
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick #122: Blue-and-white Porcelain / 青花瓷装饰语汇. Build nine distinct premium editorial scenes as complete underglaze-cobalt narratives on luminous white porcelain: confident hand-painted blue brushwork, layered cobalt washes, flowing cloud and wave bands, framed medallions, floral scrolls, vessel silhouettes and subtle glazed ceramic texture. Let each modern news subject become a different spatial scene rather than a repeated plate, generic template, three number cards or dashboard. Keep copy on calm low-texture white or pale-blue fields with strong contrast; reduce information density by about 20%, emphasize one conclusion and no more than three key facts in 3-5 readable modules, with large type, generous line spacing and breathing room. News scenes, evidence and infographics occupy at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10-15% at edges or the bottom. NO.01 is the exception: preserve all eight numbered one-sentence summaries exactly around a central porcelain globe or flowing vessel-world, using curving cobalt rivers, cloud ribbons, overlapping ceramic forms and layered foreground-background storytelling rather than a rigid eight-cell grid, table, equal cards, dense borders or tiny type. Each summary needs a quiet readable field, clear 1-8 order and no extra event. Chinese and English keep the same composition, scene, hierarchy and rhythm. Every raw image must be native 1:2 portrait, every final image exactly 887x1774, with natural undistorted faces, circles, type and characters, and artwork filling all four edges with zero non-design white strips, pillarbox, letterbox or scaling gaps.

zh-CN.headlineView: 实时语音、一人效率工具、AI口语收入、跨境奢侈品、健康安全、珊瑚风险、火卫采样与生物计算进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.headlineFull: 10月17日全球经营雷达；实时语音、一人效率工具、AI口语收入、跨境奢侈品、健康安全、珊瑚风险、火卫采样与生物计算进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.intro:
1. OpenAI开始推出GPT-Live-1.1与轻量版Quip，以全双工语音、更多自然口音和13种新声音改善实时对话。
2. Did I Do?由Jose一人运营，用主屏小组件和提醒服务日常任务管理，RevenueCat验证MRR 962美元、323个活跃订阅。
3. Practiceme用AI语音陪练、母语口音和实时反馈帮助用户练英语，RevenueCat验证MRR 3007美元、近30天收入4165美元。
4. Marc Jacobs接入Global-e本地化定价、支付、税费与退货后，国际线上收入同比增长130%、订单增长77%。
5. WHO与INTERPOL签署合作协议，把假药、非法器官交易、异常生物事件及化学放射性风险纳入健康与执法协作。
6. IUCN全球重评显示774种有足够数据的造礁珊瑚中有340种面临受威胁等级，热压力是93%高风险物种的首要驱动。
7. 日本MMX任务计划10月20日发射，目标从火卫一带回至少10克样本，并在2031年送返地球。
8. 布里斯托大学让脑类器官处理盲文触觉信号，单个解码准确率约61%，三个组合提升到83%。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 今天的共同信号，是把新能力、收入证据与公共风险都放进可核验的系统里。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先看真实结果，再区分试验、预测与已经发生的变化。

en-US.headlineView: Live voice, a solo utility, AI-speaking revenue, luxury cross-border commerce, health security, coral risk, a Mars-moon sample mission and biohybrid computing enter one action map
en-US.headlineFull: October 17 Global Operator Radar; Live voice, a solo utility, AI-speaking revenue, luxury cross-border commerce, health security, coral risk, a Mars-moon sample mission and biohybrid computing enter one action map
en-US.intro:
1. OpenAI is rolling out GPT-Live-1.1 and the lighter Quip model with full-duplex conversation, more natural accents and 13 new voices.
2. Jose runs Did I Do? alone, using home-screen widgets and reminders for daily task confidence while RevenueCat verifies $962 MRR and 323 active subscriptions.
3. Practiceme uses AI voice practice, native accents and real-time feedback for English learners while RevenueCat verifies $3,007 MRR and $4,165 in 30-day revenue.
4. Marc Jacobs recorded 130% year-on-year international online revenue growth and 77% order growth after adding Global-e localization for pricing, payment, duties and returns.
5. WHO and INTERPOL signed an agreement covering falsified medicines, organ trafficking, unusual biological events and chemical or radiological risks through health-law-enforcement cooperation.
6. An IUCN reassessment places 340 of 774 sufficiently documented reef-building coral species in threatened categories, with heat stress the leading driver for 93% of high-risk species.
7. Japan's MMX mission is scheduled to launch on October 20, collect at least 10 grams from Phobos and return the sample to Earth in 2031.
8. University of Bristol researchers routed Braille touch signals through brain organoids, with decoding rising from about 61% for one organoid to 83% for three combined.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Today's shared signal is to put new capability, revenue evidence and public risk inside verifiable systems.
en-US.doudouQuote: Start with observed outcomes, then separate experiments, forecasts and changes already delivered.

zh-CN.headlineView: 新版本保持全双工倾听与回应，加入更自然的多语种口音、13种新声音和轻量版Quip
zh-CN.headlineFull: GPT-Live-1.1开始进入ChatGPT实时语音；新版本保持全双工倾听与回应，加入更自然的多语种口音、13种新声音和轻量版Quip
zh-CN.intro: OpenAI于10月15日开始在ChatGPT Voice推出GPT-Live-1.1与轻量版GPT-Live-1.1 Quip。两者延续全双工架构，可在用户停顿、插话和语速变化时持续判断应该回应还是继续倾听；Plus及更高方案默认使用GPT-Live-1.1，其他用户默认使用Quip。产品更新加入法语、德语、印地语、日语、韩语、墨西哥西班牙语和英语等13种新声音，并扩大搜索过程中使用的短提示语。系统卡同时提示，生产语音安全评测总体无显著退步，但合成难例中在性内容、心理健康、情感依赖和血腥类别出现统计显著回退，说明更自然的声音不等于风险已经消失。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 实时语音的进步，不只是更像人，也要让用户更清楚模型何时在听、在搜、在行动。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 新声音是产品升级；安全评测中的回退同样需要被看见。

en-US.headlineFact: GPT-Live-1.1 begins rolling into ChatGPT Voice
en-US.headlineView: The update keeps full-duplex listening and response while adding more natural multilingual accents, 13 new voices and the lighter Quip model
en-US.headlineFull: GPT-Live-1.1 begins rolling into ChatGPT Voice; The update keeps full-duplex listening and response while adding more natural multilingual accents, 13 new voices and the lighter Quip model
en-US.intro: OpenAI began rolling GPT-Live-1.1 and the lighter GPT-Live-1.1 Quip into ChatGPT Voice on October 15. Both retain a full-duplex design that can interpret pauses, interruptions and changes in speaking pace while deciding whether to respond or continue listening. GPT-Live-1.1 is the default for Plus and higher tiers, while Quip is the default for other users. The release adds 13 voices spanning French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Mexican Spanish and English and broadens the short phrases used while searching. The system card says production-prompt safety evaluations showed no statistically significant overall regression, but synthetic hard cases showed significant regressions in sexual content, mental health, emotional reliance and gore, so a more natural voice is not the same as risk being solved.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Real-time voice progress is not only sounding human but making listening, searching and acting easier to supervise.
en-US.doudouQuote: New voices are a product upgrade; safety regressions deserve equal visibility.

sources.title: ChatGPT Voice: GPT-Live-1.1 brings new voices for six languages

zh-CN.headlineFact: Did I Do?一人运营，验证MRR 962美元
zh-CN.headlineView: 用主屏小组件和一次点击解决日常任务确认焦虑，323个活跃订阅支撑订阅加买断模式
zh-CN.headlineFull: Did I Do?一人运营，验证MRR 962美元；用主屏小组件和一次点击解决日常任务确认焦虑，323个活跃订阅支撑订阅加买断模式
zh-CN.intro: 西班牙创始人Jose一人运营Did I Do?，面向需要管理用药、家务和日常习惯、尤其容易因ADHD或OCD产生确认焦虑的个人用户。产品把极简任务小组件放在iPhone主屏，一次点击即可标记完成，并用可自定义通知减少用户反复打开App的摩擦。TrustMRR通过RevenueCat验证近30天收入1113美元、MRR 962美元和323个活跃订阅，数据更新于10月15日；变现采用免费入口、Plus订阅与终身买断。获客杠杆来自小组件的高频可见性、App Store分发以及创始人自有社交受众，交付主要依赖SwiftUI客户端和RevenueCat。限制是小体量订阅、平台抽成、健康场景责任、通知疲劳与竞品易复制。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人产品可以从一个很小但每天都会发生的焦虑切口开始收费。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 962美元MRR是真实起点，不等于已经跨过留存与规模化。

en-US.headlineFact: Solo-run Did I Do? verifies $962 MRR
en-US.headlineView: Home-screen widgets and one-tap completion reduce daily task uncertainty, with 323 active subscriptions supporting subscription and lifetime-purchase monetization
en-US.headlineFull: Solo-run Did I Do? verifies $962 MRR; Home-screen widgets and one-tap completion reduce daily task uncertainty, with 323 active subscriptions supporting subscription and lifetime-purchase monetization
en-US.intro: Spanish founder Jose operates Did I Do? alone for people managing medication, household duties and recurring routines, particularly users who experience confirmation anxiety around ADHD or OCD. Minimal widgets place task status on the iPhone home screen, one tap marks an item complete and customizable reminders reduce the friction of repeatedly opening an app. TrustMRR verifies through RevenueCat $1,113 in last-30-day revenue, $962 MRR and 323 active subscriptions, updated October 15. Monetization combines a free entry point, Plus subscription and lifetime purchase. Leverage comes from frequent widget visibility, App Store distribution and the founder's existing social audience, while delivery relies mainly on a SwiftUI client and RevenueCat. The limits are small subscription scale, store fees, responsibility in health-adjacent use, notification fatigue and easy imitation.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A solo product can charge by starting with one small anxiety that returns every day.
en-US.doudouQuote: $962 MRR is a verified beginning, not proof that retention and scale are solved.

sources.title: Did I Do? verified revenue profile

zh-CN.headlineView: 把AI语音、母语口音和实时反馈做成随时可练的英语陪练，以周订阅和年订阅获得222个活跃订阅
zh-CN.headlineFull: Practiceme验证MRR 3007美元；把AI语音、母语口音和实时反馈做成随时可练的英语陪练，以周订阅和年订阅获得222个活跃订阅
zh-CN.intro: Practiceme面向从初学者到职场人士的英语学习者，用AI语音陪练提供不同母语口音、即时发音与表达反馈，让用户在没有真人教师排期的情况下反复开口。TrustMRR通过RevenueCat验证其近30天收入4165美元、MRR 3007美元和222个活跃订阅，数据更新于10月16日；Pro方案按周9.99美元或按年59.99美元收费。获客渠道标注为App Store优化和SEO，交付依赖Swift客户端、Firebase与RevenueCat。商业结果说明用户愿意为低门槛口语反馈付费，但5.0分仅来自1条评分，仍需观察续订、语音推理成本、口音质量、学习成效与周订阅投诉风险。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI教育应用赚钱的关键，是把最难持续的练习变成随时可开始的反馈循环。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 3007美元MRR验证了付费，学习效果与长期续订还没有被这组数据证明。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：赚钱的AI应用落地。

en-US.headlineView: AI voice, native accents and real-time feedback become always-available English practice, monetized through weekly and annual plans across 222 active subscriptions
en-US.headlineFull: Practiceme verifies $3,007 MRR; AI voice, native accents and real-time feedback become always-available English practice, monetized through weekly and annual plans across 222 active subscriptions
en-US.intro: Practiceme serves English learners from beginners to professionals with AI voice practice, native accents and immediate pronunciation and expression feedback, letting people speak repeatedly without scheduling a human tutor. TrustMRR verifies through RevenueCat $4,165 in last-30-day revenue, $3,007 MRR and 222 active subscriptions, updated October 16. Pro costs $9.99 weekly or $59.99 annually. The listed acquisition channels are App Store optimization and SEO, while delivery runs through a Swift client, Firebase and RevenueCat. The result shows that users will pay for low-friction speaking feedback, but the 5.0 rating comes from only one review, leaving renewal, voice-inference cost, accent quality, learning outcomes and weekly-subscription complaints as major limits.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI education earns when the hardest practice becomes a feedback loop people can start at any moment.
en-US.doudouQuote: $3,007 MRR verifies payment, not learning outcomes or durable renewal.

zh-CN.headlineFact: Marc Jacobs国际线上收入同比增长130%
zh-CN.headlineView: 本地定价、30多种语言结账、税费预付与本地支付把跨境订单同比推高77%，法国收入五个月增长484%
zh-CN.headlineFull: Marc Jacobs国际线上收入同比增长130%；本地定价、30多种语言结账、税费预付与本地支付把跨境订单同比推高77%，法国收入五个月增长484%
zh-CN.intro: 美国奢侈品牌Marc Jacobs原本只能提供少量币种、国际信用卡和PayPal，跨境结账缺少本地价格、税费确定性与支付方式。接入Global-e后，品牌在三周内上线本地欢迎信息、按市场设定的MSRP与币种取整、30多种语言结账、关税和税费预付，以及德国Klarna、中国微信支付与支付宝等本地方式，并用预付退货和本地集运中心降低售后阻力。服务商案例显示，实施后三个月国际线上订单同比增长77%、电商收入增长130%；德国转化率增长155%，法国前五个月收入增长484%。赚钱机制来自品牌需求与本地化转化提升，结果为服务商与客户案例，利润仍要扣除高退货、关税、物流、欺诈管理、汇率与平台服务成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境增长往往不是再买一轮流量，而是让价格、支付、税费和退货像当地生意。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 130%是国际线上收入增长，净利润仍受退货、物流和服务费影响。

en-US.headlineFact: Marc Jacobs grew international online revenue 130% year on year
en-US.headlineView: Local pricing, checkout in 30-plus languages, prepaid duties and local payments lifted international orders 77%, while French revenue rose 484% in five months
en-US.headlineFull: Marc Jacobs grew international online revenue 130% year on year; Local pricing, checkout in 30-plus languages, prepaid duties and local payments lifted international orders 77%, while French revenue rose 484% in five months
en-US.intro: US luxury brand Marc Jacobs previously supported only a small set of currencies, international cards and PayPal, leaving cross-border shoppers without local pricing, certain landed cost or familiar payment methods. With Global-e, the brand launched in three weeks with localized welcome messages, market-specific MSRP and currency rounding, checkout in more than 30 languages, prepaid duties and taxes, and local methods including Klarna in Germany and WeChat Pay and Alipay in China. Prepaid returns and local consolidation centers reduced after-sale friction. The provider's case study reports that within three months international orders rose 77% year on year and ecommerce revenue rose 130%; German conversion increased 155% and French revenue rose 484% in five months. The earning mechanism is brand demand converted through localization. These are vendor-customer case results, and profit still subtracts returns, duties, logistics, fraud management, FX and service fees.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border growth often comes not from buying more traffic but from making price, payment, duties and returns feel local.
en-US.doudouQuote: The 130% figure is international online revenue growth; net profit still absorbs returns, logistics and service cost.

sources.title: Marc Jacobs international ecommerce success story

zh-CN.headlineFact: WHO与INTERPOL建立健康安全联合行动框架
zh-CN.headlineView: 合作覆盖假药与假医疗用品、非法器官交易、异常生物事件，以及化学和放射性材料被滥用的风险
zh-CN.headlineFull: WHO与INTERPOL建立健康安全联合行动框架；合作覆盖假药与假医疗用品、非法器官交易、异常生物事件，以及化学和放射性材料被滥用的风险
zh-CN.intro: 世界卫生组织与国际刑警组织10月16日在日内瓦和里昂宣布签署合作协议，把公共卫生专业能力与196个成员国的执法网络连接起来。框架面向需要卫生与安全同步行动的异常生物事件、疑似化学或放射性材料滥用以及大型活动健康威胁；同时针对假药、假疫苗和医疗器械、伪劣个人防护用品、虚假标注食品饮料与非法酒类。双方还将协作打击以摘取器官为目的的人口贩运和非法器官、组织、细胞交易，并支持《烟草控制框架公约》执行。协议提供协作框架而非自动执法权，效果仍取决于各国报告、证据交换、监管能力和跨境案件执行。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当犯罪网络利用健康供应链，卫生系统和执法系统就不能各自看一半。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 协议建立了协作通道，真正成效要看各国能否共享证据并持续执行。

en-US.headlineFact: WHO and INTERPOL create a joint health-security framework
en-US.headlineView: Cooperation covers falsified medicines and medical goods, illegal organ trade, unusual biological events and suspected misuse of chemical or radioactive materials
en-US.headlineFull: WHO and INTERPOL create a joint health-security framework; Cooperation covers falsified medicines and medical goods, illegal organ trade, unusual biological events and suspected misuse of chemical or radioactive materials
en-US.intro: The World Health Organization and INTERPOL announced a cooperation agreement in Geneva and Lyon on October 16, linking public-health expertise with a law-enforcement network spanning 196 member countries. The framework covers unusual biological events, suspected misuse of chemical or radioactive materials and health risks at major international gatherings that require coordinated health and security action. It also targets falsified medicines, vaccines and medical devices, counterfeit protective equipment, fraudulently labelled food and drink and illegally produced alcohol. The two bodies will cooperate against trafficking for organ removal and illegal trade in organs, tissues and cells and support implementation of the tobacco-control convention. The agreement creates a channel for cooperation rather than automatic enforcement authority; results still depend on national reporting, evidence exchange, regulatory capacity and cross-border case execution.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When criminal networks exploit health supply chains, health and policing cannot each see only half the system.
en-US.doudouQuote: The agreement creates a channel; impact depends on countries sharing evidence and enforcing cases.

sources.title: INTERPOL and WHO sign agreement to strengthen global health and security protection

zh-CN.headlineFact: 全球44%有数据的造礁珊瑚物种面临受威胁等级
zh-CN.headlineView: 774种中340种进入易危、濒危或极危，93%高风险物种的首要驱动是未来30年的热压力
zh-CN.headlineFull: 全球44%有数据的造礁珊瑚物种面临受威胁等级；774种中340种进入易危、濒危或极危，93%高风险物种的首要驱动是未来30年的热压力
zh-CN.intro: IUCN珊瑚专家组联合60多名专家重新评估892种造礁珊瑚，其中774种有足够数据可判定；340种、即44%，被列为易危、濒危或极危，包括33种极危、251种濒危和56种易危。研究显示，气候变化相关热压力决定了93%高风险物种的最终等级；大西洋有50%的受评物种受威胁，印度洋—太平洋为43%。珊瑚红色名录指数从1998年前的0.96降至2008年的0.89和2024年的0.74。作者提醒，评估数据截至2020年，未完全计入2023至2025年全球白化与2026—2027超强厄尔尼诺，因此当前风险可能更高；物种下降主要由珊瑚覆盖趋势代理估算，仍需更多直接观测。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 珊瑚不是在等待某个单一临界点，每少升温十分之一度都能保留更多恢复空间。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 44%是基于现有数据的相对灭绝风险，不是已经消失的物种比例。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：气候与生态。

en-US.headlineFact: Forty-four percent of documented reef-building coral species are threatened
en-US.headlineView: Of 774 species, 340 are Vulnerable, Endangered or Critically Endangered, with 30-year heat stress the leading driver for 93% of high-risk species
en-US.headlineFull: Forty-four percent of documented reef-building coral species are threatened; Of 774 species, 340 are Vulnerable, Endangered or Critically Endangered, with 30-year heat stress the leading driver for 93% of high-risk species
en-US.intro: The IUCN coral specialist group and more than 60 experts reassessed 892 reef-building coral species, with enough data to classify 774. Of those, 340, or 44%, fall into Vulnerable, Endangered or Critically Endangered categories: 33 Critically Endangered, 251 Endangered and 56 Vulnerable. Climate-related heat stress determines the final category for 93% of high-risk species. Half of assessed Atlantic species are threatened, compared with 43% in the Indo-Pacific. The coral Red List Index fell from 0.96 before 1998 to 0.89 in 2008 and 0.74 in 2024. The authors warn that data ending in 2020 do not fully capture the 2023-2025 global bleaching event or the 2026-2027 super El Niño, so present risk may be higher; estimated declines also use coral-cover trends as a proxy and need more direct observation.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Corals are not waiting for one magic threshold; every tenth of a degree avoided preserves more room to recover.
en-US.doudouQuote: Forty-four percent describes relative extinction risk in assessed species, not species already lost.

sources.title: Nearly half of reef-building corals face elevated relative risk of extinction

zh-CN.headlineFact: MMX计划10月20日启程采样火卫一
zh-CN.headlineView: 日本主导的任务将巡视火卫一与火卫二、两次软着陆采集至少10克样本，并在2031年送回地球
zh-CN.headlineFull: MMX计划10月20日启程采样火卫一；日本主导的任务将巡视火卫一与火卫二、两次软着陆采集至少10克样本，并在2031年送回地球
zh-CN.intro: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构的火星卫星探测任务MMX计划于10月20日4时41分03秒从种子岛搭乘H3火箭10号机发射。探测器预计2027年8月抵达火星附近，进入与火卫一相似的准卫星轨道，观察火卫一与火卫二的地形、内部结构、组成和重力；最早在2028年12月通过两次软着陆采集至少10克火卫一表面物质，2031年将返回舱送回地球。任务要检验火卫一是被火星捕获的小行星还是巨大撞击后的碎片，并研究水和有机物在早期太阳系中的输运。NASA提供伽马射线与中子谱仪、气动采样机构及深空通信支持。发射、着陆、采样和返航都仍是计划节点，不能提前当作完成。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 十克样本很轻，却可能改写我们对火星卫星和早期太阳系物质来源的判断。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 现在是发射前节点；真正答案要等采样成功并在2031年回到地球。

en-US.headlineFact: MMX is scheduled to depart for Phobos on October 20
en-US.headlineView: The Japan-led mission will survey both Martian moons, make two soft landings, collect at least 10 grams and return the sample to Earth in 2031
en-US.headlineFull: MMX is scheduled to depart for Phobos on October 20; The Japan-led mission will survey both Martian moons, make two soft landings, collect at least 10 grams and return the sample to Earth in 2031
en-US.intro: JAXA's Martian Moons eXploration mission is scheduled to launch aboard H3 Flight 10 from Tanegashima at 4:41:03 a.m. JST on October 20. The spacecraft should reach Mars in August 2027, enter a quasi-satellite orbit similar to Phobos and observe the shape, interior, composition and gravity of Phobos and Deimos. No earlier than December 2028, it plans two soft landings to collect at least 10 grams of Phobos surface material, with an Earth return in 2031. The mission will test whether Phobos is a captured asteroid or debris from a giant impact and examine how water and organics moved through the early Solar System. NASA contributes a gamma-ray and neutron spectrometer, a pneumatic sampler and deep-space communications support. Launch, landing, sampling and return remain planned milestones, not completed outcomes.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Ten grams is light, but it could change how we understand Mars's moons and material flow in the early Solar System.
en-US.doudouQuote: This is still a pre-launch milestone; the answer waits on successful sampling and a 2031 return.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 脑类器官把盲文触觉信号保留为可解码神经活动
zh-CN.headlineView: 单个类器官识别准确率约61%，三个组合提升到83%，为传感器连接生物神经网络提供实验路径
zh-CN.headlineFull: 脑类器官把盲文触觉信号保留为可解码神经活动；单个类器官识别准确率约61%，三个组合提升到83%，为传感器连接生物神经网络提供实验路径
zh-CN.intro: 布里斯托大学研究团队把约1万神经元、直径不足1毫米的脑类器官放在多电极阵列上，将触觉传感器读取的26个盲文字母转换成电刺激，再用支持向量机从类器官的神经活动中识别字母。单个类器官产生的信号约61%可被正确解码，三个类器官组合后提升到83%，并且在加入人工噪声时比直接解码被干扰的原始信号更稳健。结果发表于《Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence》，证明真实触觉信息可以经过生物神经组织后仍保留可分类结构。研究没有证明类器官能够学习、记忆或理解盲文，只测试了固定编码和单一触觉任务；个体差异、标准化、长期存活、伦理与闭环反馈仍是核心难题。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 这项实验的突破，是让传感器与活体神经网络之间出现一条可测量的信息通路。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 83%代表可解码，不代表类器官已经会读、会学或拥有意识。

en-US.headlineFact: Brain organoids preserve Braille touch signals as decodable neural activity
en-US.headlineView: Accuracy rose from about 61% for one organoid to 83% for three combined, offering an experimental route between sensors and biological neural networks
en-US.headlineFull: Brain organoids preserve Braille touch signals as decodable neural activity; Accuracy rose from about 61% for one organoid to 83% for three combined, offering an experimental route between sensors and biological neural networks
en-US.intro: University of Bristol researchers placed brain organoids containing about 10,000 neurons and measuring under one millimeter on multielectrode arrays. They converted tactile-sensor readings from all 26 Braille letters into electrical stimulation and used a support vector machine to identify letters from the organoids' neural activity. Signals from one organoid were decoded correctly about 61% of the time, rising to 83% when three organoids were combined. The combined system was also more robust to artificial noise than directly decoding the obscured input. Published in Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence, the experiment shows that real tactile information can pass through biological neural tissue while retaining classifiable structure. It does not show learning, memory, Braille understanding or consciousness; organoid variability, standardization, long-term viability, ethics and closed-loop feedback remain central challenges.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The breakthrough is a measurable information path between an artificial sensor and living neural tissue.
en-US.doudouQuote: Eighty-three percent means decodable signals, not that organoids can read, learn or possess awareness.

sources.title: Mini brain organoids reading Braille mark step towards biohybrid computing
